name: PHP
body: security.txt, HSTS, framing limited to its origin, and robots.txt open to AI crawlers. But all 39 URLs in its sitemap use http://php.net, not the https://www.php.net address the site serves.
lesson: Generate the sitemap from your canonical URLs: same scheme, same host. Every redirect in it wastes crawl.
summary: www.php.net scores 77 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 23 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 39 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 39 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: php.net (39). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.php.net.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /downloads.php, /releases/8.5/en.php. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 19 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: /downloads.php has no self reference, /docs.php has no self reference, /get-involved.php has no self reference and 16 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages read.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 476 ms
